decision: Use the existing read-only InlineHintSnapshotV1 as a revision barrier after GNOME frontend focus/session invalidation. Suppress painting until the current barrier completes, consume its revision without painting it, and accept only later stream revisions. Coalesce focus changes behind one in-flight request.
reason: Prior review identified a queued positive live signal that repaints after the frontend hides the view but before the engine clear arrives. The former startup-snapshot guard did not fence live signals.
verification: Remote controlled RED 9 PASS / 3 FAIL; GREEN 12/12 PASS. Harness2 task 20261020T162925Z-d839cac8, all eight calls completed, independent review 8/10. Root separately verified frozen input hashes and GREEN logs. Acceptance: /home/ubu/.cache/lay/development/browser-final-fixes-20261018/inline-focus-repair-review-20261020T162918Z/acceptance.json. Native GNOME and broader producer-lag guarantee remain OPEN.
consequences: One coalesced read-only snapshot on frontend focus invalidation uses the existing 1000ms display-call timeout, outside keyboard processing. No timers, polling, input callback, edit grant, text executor or source migration. Failure stays hidden with no automatic retry; a later focus or service owner can request again. This fences already-published queued signals. It is not an acknowledgement of the document or proof that an old producer cannot generate a new frame while its IBus FocusOut is delayed. That broader cross-frontend/producer focus guarantee remains OPEN and must not be promoted from these tests.
not_tested: Native changed-byte GNOME, remote Wayland, producer-lag cross-window frame identity and full browser matrices.
